result.topic_en: Draft of an official report on General-Lieutenant Baeyer's geodetic project (the European arc measurement). It argues that comparing astronomical and geodetic longitude determinations to fix the Earth's shape is a self-contained investigation, so the Royal Hanoverian government need not take part in that part.

items.english: The comparison of the astronomical and longitude determinations with the geodetic ones, for a more exact determination of the figure of the Earth, forms a self-contained scientific investigation for which the cooperation of several parties is not required.
